# Rewired Ketamine
# https://www.rewiredketamine.com

> Locally owned ketamine clinic in Aventura, Florida offering fully guided IV ketamine therapy for depression, anxiety, PTSD, and chronic pain. Serving Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and South Florida. Spanish spoken.
